responsibility: Provides low-level token and statement matching helpers used by the Fortran parser. It recognizes intrinsic and user-defined operators, member separators, prefix constructs, and other syntactic fragments, and it builds the parser state needed for variable, operator, and control-structure recognition before full semantic resolution occurs.
same_name_distinction: Implements the parser’s low-level matching routines that recognize operators, separators, statement forms, and construct-specific syntax while building parser state. Unlike gcc/fortran/match.h, it contains the actual token/statement matching code instead of the matcher declarations and shared globals.
